remarks: Style of residence: Condo - Apartment Style on ground floor ** Fall in love with low-maintenance living in this updated one-bedroom, first-floor condo in desirable Foxberry Village. Natural light fills the open living space, creating a bright and welcoming feel from the moment you walk in. The spacious living room flows into the updated kitchen, featuring quartz countertops and plenty of cabinet space. Large sliding glass doors bring in even more sunlight and lead to your private covered patio—perfect for morning coffee or relaxing outdoors. The bedroom offers generous closet space and a ceiling fan, while the updated bathroom, central A/C, and convenient first-floor laundry add to the comfort and ease of everyday living. All appliances are included! Enjoy easy, no-stairs entry and plenty of open parking. Residents also have access to the community pool and picnic area. Cats and one dog under 30 lbs. are welcome. Located in the Williamsville School District in the Town of Amherst, with low HOA fees and taxes. Conveniently located near the 990, shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Move-in ready, bright, comfortable, and convenient—this one is ready to welcome you home! **Open house coming soon!**
